basis: April 30, 2025 is the earliest qualifying communication I verified. Tennant’s consolidated income statement reports Q1 2025 net sales of $290.0 million against $311.0 million for Q1 2024, a reported decline of 6.8%. The cutoff was $295.45 million. The onset date remains unresolved because management announced a March 20 CL King investor conference, and I could not verify whether Tennant made public remarks there or what it disclosed.

coverage.detail: October 31, 2024, Q3 release. Tennant reaffirmed full-year 2024 net sales of $1.280–$1.305 billion. That range places no bound on Q1 2025.
November 1, Q3 call. Management described the 2024 backlog reduction as a headwind for 2025. It gave no numeric Q1 2025 consolidated sales ceiling.
November 2024 Baird investor presentation. Slide 23 repeated the full-year 2024 sales range.
February 17, 2025, Q4 release. Tennant forecast full-year 2025 net sales of $1.210–$1.250 billion and a full-year organic decline of 1%–4%. Neither figure establishes a Q1 reported-sales ceiling.
February 18 earnings presentation. The guidance slide tied the annual outlook to expected order growth and the prior-year backlog reduction. It supplied no Q1 reported-sales range.

February 18 call transcript. At 26:57 the CFO described Q1 and Q3 as seasonally lower-volume quarters, without quantifying a year-over-year Q1 decline. At 29:51 the CEO announced the March 19 Sidoti and March 20 CL King events. I found no public replay, transcript or presentation establishing what Tennant disclosed at the latter event.
March 19 Sidoti conference transcript. Management discussed the $125 million of backlog reduced during 2024 and expected 2025 order growth. Neither figure bounds consolidated Q1 2025 net sales.
April 17 issuer notice. Tennant scheduled results for after market close April 30 and the call for May 1. The notice contained no preliminary Q1 sales figure.

April 30 actuals. Tennant published both quarters on the same consolidated GAAP net-sales line. It separately reported a 5.0% organic decline. The $290.0 million actual was $5.45 million below the cutoff.
The subsequent Form 10-Q confirms $290.0 million and $311.0 million in the consolidated statements of income for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024.

publication_date_evidence: Tennant’s IR results page displays 04/30/2025, and the SEC-hosted earnings exhibit carries the same April 30 dateline. These establish when the actual became public. The unresolved March 20 conference coverage prevents certification of the earliest date.
